item.text: {"status":"confirmed","reasoning":"All four answers agree with the earlier answers and their own captured Math Academy worked solutions. q-31991: x⁴−y⁶=(x²)²−(y³)², so the difference of squares gives (x²+y³)(x²−y³). q-113303: writing both fractions over g(2−h) gives (5g−3)/(g(2−h)), for g≠0 and h≠2. q-86327: cosine is the unit-circle x-coordinate, so cos(π/4)=√2/2. q-122083: selecting one attraction gives 5+7+3=15 choices.","confidence":1,"answers":[{"key":"q-31991/selection","correct_value":"({x}^{2}+{y}^{3})({x}^{2}-{y}^{3})","correct_option":"2","value_type":"math","wrong_value":"({x}^{2}+{y}^{2})({x}^{2}-{y}^{2})","correct_keys":[],"wrong_keys":[],"ma_value":"({x}^{2}+{y}^{3})({x}^{2}-{y}^{3})","ma_basis":"worked_solution","ma_evidence":"Verbatim from q-31991: \"{({x}^{2})}^{2}-{({y}^{3})}^{2}=({x}^{2}+{y}^{3})({x}^{2}-{y}^{3})\"","disagrees":false},{"key":"q-113303/selection","correct_value":"\\frac{5g-3}{g(2-h)}","correct_option":"4","value_type":"math","wrong_value":"\\frac{2g}{g(2-h)}","correct_keys":[],"wrong_keys":[],"ma_value":"\\frac{5g-3}{g(2-h)}","ma_basis":"worked_solution","ma_evidence":"Verbatim from q-113303: \"\\frac{5g}{g(2-h)}-\\frac{3}{g(2-h)} & = \\\\ \\frac{5g-3}{g(2-h)} & \\end{aligned}\"","disagrees":false},{"key":"q-86327/selection","correct_value":"\\frac{\\sqrt{2}}{2}","correct_option":"2","value_type":"math","wrong_value":"\\frac{\\sqrt{3}}{2}","correct_keys":[],"wrong_keys":[],"ma_value":"\\frac{\\sqrt{2}}{2}","ma_basis":"worked_solution","ma_evidence":"Verbatim from q-86327: \"Since the cosine of the angle corresponds to the $x$-coordinate, we have $cos⁡(\\frac{\\pi }{4})=\\frac{\\sqrt{2}}{2}.$\"","disagrees":false},{"key":"q-122083/selection","correct_value":"15","correct_option":"2","value_type":"math","wrong_value":"12","correct_keys":[],"wrong_keys":[],"ma_value":"15","ma_basis":"worked_solution","ma_evidence":"Verbatim from q-122083: \"Therefore, there are $15$ choices of attractions.\"","disagrees":false}]}
